step1_analysis.description: The circuit consists of two independent common-source amplifier stages with active loads. One stage uses a PMOS input with an NMOS current sink load, and the other uses an NMOS input with a PMOS current source load.

paper_reference.title: A 3.2 to 4GHz, 0.25µm CMOS Frequency Synthesizer for IEEE 802.11a/b/g WLAN

Operating Frequency.description: Target oscillation/synthesis frequency of the PLL

sky130_expected.reasoning: This metric applies to the full synthesizer. The extracted circuit is a baseband/buffer amplifier.

Phase Noise.description: Phase noise of the synthesizer at specific offsets

sky130_expected.reasoning: Applies to the full PLL/VCO, not measurable on this isolated buffer.

Spurious Tones.description: Reference spurs in the synthesizer output

sky130_expected.reasoning: Applies to the full PLL, not measurable here.

Voltage Gain (Amp 1).description: Low-frequency voltage gain of the PMOS-input stage

sky130_expected.calculation: gm_p = 2*Id/Vov_p = 2*10uA/0.2V = 100uS. Rout = ro_p || ro_n = 1M || 1M = 500k. Gain = 100uS * 500k = 50 V/V = 34 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on SKY130 parameters with 10uA bias current.

Voltage Gain (Amp 2).description: Low-frequency voltage gain of the NMOS-input stage

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on SKY130 parameters with 10uA bias current.

Unity Gain Frequency (Amp 1).description: Frequency where the voltage gain of Amp 1 drops to 0 dB

Unity Gain Frequency (Amp 2).description: Frequency where the voltage gain of Amp 2 drops to 0 dB

Power Consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: Total current = I_bias + I_amp1 + I_amp2 = 10uA + 10uA + 10uA = 30uA. Power = 30uA * 1.8V = 54uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the 10uA bias current applied in the testbench.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, unity gain frequency, and power consumption of the two common-source amplifier stages.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Common-Source Amplifiers Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u

XM1 N6 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N4 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N6 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 N5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
Ibias VDD N1 10u
Vbias3 N3 0 1.18

* Self-biasing resistors for DC operating point
R1 N6 N0 100Meg
R2 N4 N5 100Meg

* AC coupling capacitors
C1 in1 N0 1
C2 in2 N5 1

* Input sources (DC=0, AC=1, Sine for Tran)
V1 in1 0 dc 0 ac 1 sin(0 1m 1Meg)
V2 in2 0 dc 0 ac 1 sin(0 1m 1Meg)

* Load capacitors
CL1 N6 0 10f
CL2 N4 0 10f

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power
print v(N6) v(N4) v(N0) v(N5) v(N1) v(N3)

ac dec 100 1k 10G
let gain1_db = vdb(N6)
let gain2_db = vdb(N4)

meas ac dc_gain1 find gain1_db at=10k
meas ac dc_gain2 find gain2_db at=10k

meas ac ugf1 when gain1_db=0 fall=1
meas ac ugf2 when gain2_db=0 fall=1

tran 10n 5u
meas tran out1_pp pp v(N6) from=2u to=5u
meas tran out2_pp pp v(N4) from=2u to=5u

quit
.endc
